records.title: PART_ILHAS — ciclo de conversas com Artemisa Ferreira
records.media_source: Founder-supplied official PART_ILHAS event flyer (1ª edição, 2026)
records.media_provenance: Official event flyer supplied directly by the founder on 2026-08-29 as the exact image published on the Agenda Cultural de Cabo Verde listing for this event; ingested byte-for-byte as supplied (1110 × 1387 baseline JPEG, 345012 bytes, sha256 7be0099fdbe43429f267df2e55e5f52e713eaa99eb2d8674b845fc74eb9a0fca, not re-encoded, not cropped). Both official source hosts were unreachable from the implementation environment (egress policy denied CONNECT to www.agendacultural.cv and cvcultural.cv), so founder supply is the provenance route — the same route already used for the Nuno Miranda PART_ILHAS flyer. The flyer confirms date, time, venue, guest, 1ª edição 2026, Entrada Livre, and the Ministério da Cultura e das Indústrias Criativas / Centro Cultural do Mindelo (CCM) marks. Institutional logos are part of the flyer artwork only and are not separately authorized or extracted.
records.media_alt: PART_ILHAS 1ª edição 2026 poster: Ciclo Conversas with Artemisa Ferreira, cineasta/poetisa, Saturday 29 August at 18h30, entrada livre, at Centro Cultural do Mindelo, over a photograph of stony ground crossed by the shadow of a person holding a camera.

records.title: Simabo
records.source_url: Direct correspondence with Simabo (Stefany and Silvia) and the Simabo-supplied volunteer leaflet, 27 August 2026
records.media_source: Simabo-supplied volunteer leaflet (dog walking and cat volunteering)
records.media_provenance: Volunteer leaflet supplied directly by Silvia (Simabo) on 27 August 2026 and explicitly authorized for A PRASA use as current Simabo volunteer supporting/promotional media. Ingested byte-for-byte as supplied (1035 × 1600 PNG, not re-encoded, not cropped). It is the main provider image for this record: shown contained on the compact card via the existing card-media-poster pattern and full-width in the Details dialog, where the leaflet text is readable. The dog/cat mark inside the leaflet is part of the leaflet artwork only — it is NOT separately authorized, and no standalone Simabo logo asset was extracted or created. No unrelated Simabo photography is authorized by this grant.
records.media_alt: Simabo volunteer leaflet: volunteer at our shelters — walk our dogs or hang out with the cats. Visit the dog shelter every day from 7 am to 1 pm or 1 pm to 6:30 pm; hang out with the cats from 9 am to 6 pm in the office building.
